### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **4** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx`  _(via validateScreenInputs (symbol, a top-level function))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **145** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `a5bdd4e245183be5559ab70e9ba25b8b251430ba` — the merge of head `9c17572c2da999a01edf567e4a95bab87b771d1d` into base `a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin a5bdd4e245183be5559ab70e9ba25b8b251430ba && git checkout a5bdd4e245183be5559ab70e9ba25b8b251430ba
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a 9c17572c2da999a01edf567e4a95bab87b771d1d && git checkout -B drift-repro a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a && git merge --no-ff 9c17572c2da999a01edf567e4a95bab87b771d1d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs a335f1defbea57ffe552d2e9efc5ad8d56a2e76a` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9c17572c2da999a01edf567e4a95bab87b771d1d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/automation/builtin-node-config.zod.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts + packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-contract.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/screen-input-file-field.test.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/screen-file-field-resume.test.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ScreenView.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/FlowRunner.fileField-25801.test.tsx, packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-screen-file-intake.dogfood.test.ts, packages/qa/dogfood/test/fixtures/flow-screen-file-fixture.ts, .changeset/25801-flow-screen-file-field.md, content/docs/references/automation/builtin-node-config.mdx, content/docs/automation/flows.mdx; read unchanged for the claims those hunks make: packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts (`isFileIdToken`), packages/services/service-storage/src/file-reference-lifecycle.ts (the claim path's read check), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts (`fileIdOf`), ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/uploadingScope.tsx, docs/adr/0104-field-runtime-value-shape-contract.md (D3).

Inputs: card #25801, its body and all eight comments (claim 6415695572, amendment 6417676103, os-dev-reports 6417535261 and 6418524489; 6417697490 is a declared duplicate); PR #26134's body and file list as live at this read, its net diff against `main` at the head (14 files, +959/-48), and the check-runs on the head. The relay's queued title and body update had already landed when I read the PR: the title carries `!` (rename event by `objectstack-fleet[bot]`) and the body is byte-equal to the seat's intended file `issue-25801/pr-26134-body-9c17572c.md` bar a trailing newline, so this record judges the live PR, which is the intended one. Check-runs: every gate-carrying run on the head concluded `success`, including the second `Check Changeset` run (121632617419) that followed the rename; the skipped runs are opt-in and matrix placeholders. No governed surface is in the file list, the head repo is the base repo, the PR is a draft, and 1007 changed lines sit under the 3,000-line threshold.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The resume door's accept set narrows for `type: 'file'` — RIGHT.** `validateScreenInputs` now keys a closed module-level map `SCREEN_FIELD_VALUE_DOMAINS` (`number`, `file`) in place of the `field.type !== 'number'` guard; a present value on a `file` field must satisfy `isFileIdToken`, else `invalid_type` with "must be the id of an uploaded file". The pass keeps the number pass's conditioning: an absent or empty value is `required`'s question, a field hidden by `visibleWhen` is not judged. `screen-input-file-field.test.ts` pins two minted ids admitted, six wrong shapes refused with the exact message (download URL, absolute URL, expanded read form, legacy inline blob, list, number), door/predicate agreement on seven values, absence, a hidden field with its positive control, and `image`/`avatar`/`video`/`audio` left open. `screen-file-field-resume.test.ts` pins the pause carrying `type: 'file'`, a URL resume refused before any insert with the pause surviving, and an id reaching `create_record` unchanged. The dogfood test pins the same at the REST doors as a plain member: 400 `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT` for a URL and for the expanded form, no record and no claim, then the corrected resume landing on the same run.
2. **One arbiter — RIGHT.** `isFileIdToken` (`field-value.zod.ts`, uuid/nanoid-shaped, letters, digits, `_`, `-`, 1 to 64 characters) is ADR-0104 D3 wave 2's single predicate, read at the head by objectql's expand path, service-storage's claim path and backfill, plugin-approvals, and `@object-ui/fields`' `fileIdOf`. The door admits exactly what the claimer can claim; the test asserts that agreement. A URL can never match (it carries `:`, `/` or `.`).
3. **Spec surface — RIGHT, nothing authorable moves.** `ScreenFieldConfigSchema.type` stays `z.string().optional()`; only `.describe()` and the TSDoc change, and `content/docs/references/automation/builtin-node-config.mdx` is regenerated for both screen variants. `ScreenFieldSpec.type` in `contracts/automation-service.ts` stays `type?: string`, docblock only. No export is added, removed or re-typed, so the api-surface and authorable-surface gates (inside the green `TypeScript Type Check` job) are the right readers of this.
4. **The docblock's claim-path sentences — RIGHT, read in the cited code.** `file-reference-lifecycle.ts` asks the download door's `authorizeRead` verdict as the write's caller (#25692) and returns null for `isSystem` and context-less writes, so "under the default `runAs: 'user'` the claim first makes the read check; a `runAs: 'system'` write is not judged" is what the code does. This PR does not touch service-storage. The dogfood fixture's flow runs `runAs: 'user'`, so the claim is proven on that path: `status: 'committed'`, `ref_object`, `ref_id`, `ref_field` on the `sys_file` row after the write, read back through the data door.
5. **Console — RIGHT.** `ScreenView` resolves `getLazyFieldWidget('file')` through the registry `ActionParamDialog` uses; `screenResumeValues` reduces each file field through `fileIdOf` and passes a no-id value through so the engine names it; `FlowRunner` wraps the screen body in `UploadingScopeProvider`, gates Submit on `uploads.anyUploading`, short-circuits `submit()` on it, and reads the `fields.file.uploading` key `FileField` already owns. `screenResumeValues` is exported from `ScreenView.tsx` only; the package index does not re-export that module, so `@object-ui/app-shell` gains no public surface. Seven app-shell tests; `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI` and all sixteen `Test UI` shards green.
6. **The value-domain set stays closed — RIGHT.** The other media hints remain widget hints (tested), and the docblock says a member joins by ruling.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/25801-flow-screen-file-field.md`: `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-automation` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, the three published packages the diff moves (`private` unset, all in the `fixed` group). A `semantic` kind takes at least `minor` on a moved package: RIGHT. `check-changeset-no-major` is inside the green Lint job; both `Check Changeset` runs are green.
- `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: semantic`, line-initial in the changeset and the PR body, equal to the amended claim 6417676103: RIGHT. Narrowing, because the resume accept set shrinks for a field already declared `type: 'file'`. Semantic, because `type` stays an open string so nothing is refused at publish, while the already-accepted value `'file'` changes meaning from a text input to an upload whose resume admits an id only; nothing is `added` (the value was accepted before) and nothing is `narrowed` at authoring.
- BREAKING banner present with Before, Now and Fix, a FROM → TO for a caller that resumes without the console, and the title carries `!`. The dev measured zero producers of a `type: 'file'` screen field in examples or packages.
- ADR-0087 disposition: exactly one marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: RIGHT on the gate's own definition. No spec key, export, stored row or stored shape is added, removed, renamed or re-shaped, so `objectstack migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite; the FROM → TO names the request body a caller posts, not a consumer source rewrite. `check-adr-0087-registration` accepted it on the head, as report 6418524489 quotes and the green Lint job confirms.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Declaration-lines deviation (report 6417535261): answered. The seat amended the claim (6417676103); changeset, PR body and title now match it.
- File-surface deviation (no service-storage edit; `FlowRunner.tsx` edited for part 1 only; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` of #26011 untouched): answered. The #25951 claim lifecycle is used unchanged, read in `file-reference-lifecycle.ts`; the file list confirms, and the single-writer guards on the head are green.
- `Part of #25801` keyword and the pre-push trailer reword without override: answered; the Part-of guards on the head are green.
- Open question, part 2 (closing a paused run's dialog): escalated to #26149 (`needs-user-decision`, open), and report 6418524489 carries `open_questions: []`. Not in this PR; nothing here pre-empts it (closing still calls `onClose` only).
- PR title and body handed to the seat (report 6418524489): answered; the live PR carries both.
- `flows.mdx` outside the claim's surface: answered; it closes the docs-drift row (`validateScreenInputs`) and is docs only.
- Three noted-not-filed findings (console lowercases `type` while the engine matches exactly; one file per field with no `multiple`, `accept` or `maxSize`; a `runAs: 'system'` write unchecked): accepted as acceptance notes under Prime Directive 10. Each is pre-existing for `number` and `text` respectively, none is a defect this diff introduces, the system-write posture is #25951's and is stated in the docblock and the changeset, and the case asymmetry is not an authoring trap today because the widget posts an id whatever the case. If `file` ever grows widget-side limits, the case asymmetry wants its own card first.
- `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review owed before the queue (report 6417535261): this record.
- Landing stays the owning seat's: draft PR, no governed surface, no fork, under 3,000 lines.
